Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
ak...@netcom.com (Steven E Barnes) writes:

>Does a dodge card cancel one strike, or all strikes
>in a round of combat.

One strike:dodge will negat ONE and only one other strike (the
mathing one, if you both have multiple strikes.)

>It is getting real annoying dodging those machine guns,
>and "only" taking 3 damage instead of 9 because of multiple
>strikes...

Sorry, Jyhad can be an annoying game when playing against a lucky (or
well-made) deck :-)

>-steve

Messages.Author: Paul Schaaf
Messages.Body:
A dodge dodges one strike. You can use skin of steel to prevent all
damage from all strikes in a round, or you can use a card that lets you
end combat to avoid all strikes.
